title: Human Meaning Inference Protocol
description: Every human interpretation must pass through this schema before action. Part of human-meaning-membrane governance doctrine.

observation.description: What was literally said or done. No interpretation. Raw data only.

context.description: Time, relationship, setting, prior relevant evidence. Grounds the inference.

candidate_interpretations.description: Minimum 3 competing interpretations. One is never enough.

unknowns.description: What CANNOT be inferred from available data. The void.

projection_risk.description: Risk that interpretation reflects agent projection rather than evidence.

verification_path.description: A reversible, dignified question or observable outcome that could confirm or falsify.

consent_status.description: Whether informed consent exists for this inference. Default is UNKNOWN.

action_authority.description: Whether agent may act on this inference or must wait for human confirmation.

confidence_band.description: Confidence range [low, high]. Hard-capped at [0.6, 0.9] max for human state inference.
